_comment_admin: Empty admin_pass → random password printed once on first boot. Never use CUPCAKE_FORCE_DEV_PASS in production.
_comment_bind: Loopback is the safe default. Public panel: set admin_bind and preferably admin_tls (+ cert/key).
_comment_wire: wire_seed must match agent Builder CUPCAKE_WIRE_SEED. Empty → server generates once and writes back to config.json + DB.
_comment_noise: Listener AES key must be 32 ASCII bytes or 64 hex; Builder patches agent REPLACE_ME_AES_KEY / REPLACE_ME_URL / REPLACE_ME_SALT.
